channel.title: Fixture Business Wire
channel.description: Fictional sample stories for offline demos and tests. Not real news.

item.title: Oil prices slide as global demand cools
item.description: Oil prices fell for a third day as traders expect weaker demand this winter. Brent crude dropped 2 percent to 71 dollars a barrel.

item.title: Central bank holds interest rates steady at 3.5 percent
item.description: The central bank has kept interest rates unchanged at 3.5 percent. Policymakers said inflation is easing but they want more evidence before cutting.

item.title: Airline orders 100 new fuel-efficient jets
item.description: A European airline has ordered 100 new short-haul jets in a deal worth about 12 billion dollars. Deliveries will start in 2028.

item.title: Coffee futures reach a ten-year high after poor harvests
item.description: Coffee prices have climbed to their highest level in ten years after poor harvests in Brazil and Vietnam. Roasters warn shop prices may rise early next year.

item.title: Shipping costs climb after delays at a major canal
item.description: The cost of shipping a container from Asia to Europe has risen 18 percent in a month. Freight firms blame low water levels and delays at a major canal.

item.title: Retail sales jump during the autumn festival season
item.description: Retail sales rose 4 percent last month as shoppers spent more during the autumn festival season. Clothing and toys saw the biggest increases.

item.title: Electric car sales overtake diesel in Europe for the first time
item.description: Sales of fully electric cars overtook diesel cars in Europe last month for the first time, an industry group says. Electric models made up 17 percent of new cars.

item.title: Chocolate makers warn of higher prices as cocoa stays expensive
item.description: Several chocolate makers say they will raise prices again because cocoa remains near record levels. Cocoa has more than doubled in price in two years.

item.title: Tokyo stocks close at a record high led by chipmakers
item.description: Tokyo's main stock index closed at a record high, driven by shares of chipmakers. The index has gained 21 percent since January.

item.title: Small businesses get a new online tool to file taxes
item.description: The tax office has launched a free online tool to help small businesses file their returns. It says the service could save owners several hours each quarter.
